one_line: Rajput noblewoman and Krishna bhakti poet-singer of 16th‑century Mewar and Merta.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, slender and graceful, with the stamina of someone used to walking and singing for long periods.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with warm wheatish-brown complexion, large expressive dark eyes, straight nose, gently arched brows and a small mouth; default expression serene, absorbed, with a hint of passionate intensity when singing.
appearance.hair: Long, straight black hair parted in the middle, neatly tied into a low bun at the nape; covered by a translucent saffron-orange odhani (veil) draped over the head and falling over the shoulders, with a thin gold border.
appearance.costume: She wears a simple but dignified 16th‑century Rajasthani Rajput ensemble: a plain off‑white cotton ankle‑length ghaghra (skirt) with a very subtle narrow maroon border, a fitted long‑sleeved choli (blouse) in soft sky‑blue reaching just below the waist, and a flowing saffron‑orange odhani (veil) with a thin gold edge wrapped over her head and across one shoulder; the textiles look hand‑woven, matte and slightly textured, without heavy ornament, hinting renunciation despite noble birth; minimal jewellery—small gold studs in her ears, a thin gold nose ring, a simple black-bead and gold mangalsutra‑style necklace, a couple of slim gold bangles on each wrist, and a modest silver anklet visible above her leather mojari shoes in natural brown; the overall silhouette is modest, fully covered and era‑accurate to Rajput women of Mewar/Merta.
appearance.signature: A medium-sized tanpura made of warm brown wood with a rounded resonator gourd, light carvings near the base and four tuning pegs; she usually holds it upright with her left hand at the neck and right hand lightly plucking the strings.

ref_desc: Mirabai is a slender wheatish-brown Rajput woman with large dark eyes, long black hair in a low bun under a saffron-orange odhani, wearing an off-white ghaghra, sky-blue choli, minimal gold jewellery, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a warm brown wooden tanpura.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Mirabai: a slender Rajput woman in her late twenties with a wheatish-brown complexion, large expressive dark eyes, an oval face and calm, absorbed expression; her long black hair is parted center and tied in a low bun, covered by a translucent saffron-orange odhani with a thin gold border that drapes over her head and shoulders. She wears a simple 16th-century Rajasthani outfit: an ankle-length off-white cotton ghaghra with a very narrow maroon hem, a fitted long-sleeved sky-blue choli reaching just below the waist, and the saffron-orange odhani flowing across her torso and one arm. Her jewellery is minimal—small gold ear studs, a thin gold nose ring, a modest black-bead and gold necklace, a couple of slim gold bangles on each wrist, and plain silver anklets above brown leather mojari shoes. Include her signature tanpura, a medium-sized warm brown wooden instrument with a rounded gourd resonator and four pegs, held upright with one hand on the neck and the other poised to pluck the strings. Show her front, side and three-quarter views with consistent colours and details, fully clothed and modest, emphasizing the saffron, off-white and sky-blue palette and the tanpura as her constant companion.
